# DAS Trader Pro — How to import trades from  DAS Trader Pro into TradeZella using the file upload method?

Source: https://help.tradezella.com/en/articles/6730146-das-trader-pro-how-to-import-trades-from-das-trader-pro-into-tradezella-using-the-file-upload-method

Follow our straightforward guide to ensure your trades from DAS Trader Pro are imported into TradeZella accurately and seamlessly.



## Exporting trade data from DAS Trader Pro into a file



### Login to DAS Trader Pro

- Open your DAS Trader Pro desktop platform.

Open your DAS Trader Pro desktop platform.

### Access the Trades Window

- Click on the Trades window in your layout.

Click on the Trades window in your layout.

- If you don’t see the Trades tab, Navigate to the top menu and click on Trade.Select Trades to add it to your layout.

If you don’t see the Trades tab,

- Navigate to the top menu and click on Trade.

Navigate to the top menu and click on Trade.

- Select Trades to add it to your layout.

Select Trades to add it to your layout.



### Configure the Columns

- Ensure the following columns are added:Time, Symb, Side, Price, Qty, Route, Broker, Account, Type, Cloid.

Ensure the following columns are added:

- Time, Symb, Side, Price, Qty, Route, Broker, Account, Type, Cloid.

Time, Symb, Side, Price, Qty, Route, Broker, Account, Type, Cloid.



To configure:

- Right-click on the Trades window and select Config from the dropdown.

Right-click on the Trades window and select Config from the dropdown.

- In the popup: Double-click the Columns button.

In the popup: Double-click the Columns button.

- Add the required columns.

Add the required columns.



💡 To include fees, add the EcnFees column.



Note: If trading options, You will need to right-click on the option chain window and then select config > Use Full Option Symbol.



### Export to CSV

- Save your trades by exporting the data to a CSV file.

Save your trades by exporting the data to a CSV file.



## Uploading the exported file into TradeZella

- Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

Visit the TradeZella Add Trade page here or by clicking the “Add Trade” button on the sidebar.

- On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

On the Add Trade page, click “Add New Account” if you’re creating a new account for these trades.

If you’re uploading trades to an existing account, simply click on the “Add Trades” button in the account field:

- On the Add New Account page, select DAS Trader Pro as the broker and click Continue.

On the Add New Account page, select DAS Trader Pro as the broker and click Continue.

- Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

Next, select the File Upload method and click Continue again.

- On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.

On the final step, select the timezone of the file and upload the file. The system will handle the rest.



## Common Errors

- If your import fails, please make sure your file contains the following headers:​Time, Symb, Side, Price, Qty, Route, Broker, Account, Type, Cloid

If your import fails, please make sure your file contains the following headers:

- ​Time, Symb, Side, Price, Qty, Route, Broker, Account, Type, Cloid

​Time, Symb, Side, Price, Qty, Route, Broker, Account, Type, Cloid



By following these steps, you’ll keep your trading data accurate and up-to-date in TradeZella.
